time_step_starting_state_note: The 2.5 s case uses the completed initial 5 s phase-zero field as a continuation seed after the initial 5 s run showed 0.1096 K drift. Starting states are captured; every selected final solution independently meets the unchanged matching-phase periodicity criterion. This startup choice was made before observing 2.5 s results.
forcing_sampling_note: The 10 s forcing table and finite-Earth-disk quadrature are held fixed in the solver time-step sequence; their own sampling convergence is outside this study.
mesh_note: Anisotropic geometry-aware refinement; no uniform-ratio Richardson extrapolation or GCI is claimed. Thin regions are intervals <=2 mm.
interpretation: Targets are analyst-selected screening criteria, not a universal accuracy guarantee. Failed targets will be reported and additional refinement considered.
angular_study_basis: Added after inspecting HEMIOPT=20, before observing higher-resolution angular results. Official ANSYS documentation identifies higher HRES as a means of increasing view-factor accuracy.

adaptive_spatial_check.rule: If the 10 mm / thin-2 to 7.5 mm / thin-3 comparison fails any fixed screening target, add one 6 mm / thin-3 case; report any remaining failed target explicitly.
adaptive_spatial_check.starting_field: Piecewise trilinear interpolation of the qualified 7.5 mm final phase-zero field.
adaptive_spatial_check.planning_timing: Specified after the 10 mm result, before observing the 7.5 mm result. The original acceptance targets remain unchanged.
